entities.summary: Nicholas Jacob Martin is an American former professional football center. He played college football for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish and was selected by the Houston Texans in the second round of the 2016 NFL draft. Martin was also a member of the Las Vegas Raiders, New Orleans Saints, and Washington Commanders.
